'''Yuki''' (Japanese: '''ユウキ''' ''Yūki'') is a character who appeared in [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]]. She is a beautiful young woman who has trained her Pokémon to be expert chefs in Pokémon cooking contests.  She is an arrogant young Trainer who competed with [[Shu]] to win a {{p|Chansey}}.
